Jana (PM): Morning team. Need a short decision thread: customers pushing batching+caching+quant recs and eval-triggered alerts. Proposal: shrink Q2 scope into a safe Phase 1 that gives customers tangible value without touching serving hot paths. Thoughts?

Eric (Eng): Agree on shrinking. Key constraint: advisor must be non-invasive. If we only emit suggestions (JSON recs + rollout instructions) and avoid changing runtime behavior, low infra risk.

Maria (ML): Alert hygiene is the big win or pain. MVP alert set: per-prompt accuracy drop, p95 latency spike, unexpected token-cost deltas. Use hybrid thresholds (relative + absolute) to reduce noise.

Tom (SE): Quant recommendations should be conservative presets first. Ship: SAFE_INT8 (recommended for non-critical routes) and FP16_CONSERVATIVE. Auto-tune and layerwise quant follow-ups can be Phase 2.

Priya (CS): Customers Alpha/Kanga want per-route caching guidance and a playbook for safe rollouts. They can pilot with us and provide labeled eval sets.

Jana (PM): Concrete Phase 1 (6w) proposal: advisor CLI + small read-only dashboard; two static rec types (batching size heuristic + quant preset chooser); eval-triggered alert hook (opt-in webhook to eval-sentry); pilot onboarding + runbook. Deliverable must not require runtime changes.

Eric (Eng): Technically feasible. Implementation plan: rec-generator service (offline), advisor API to surface recs, dashboard widget (read-only). Alerts: reuse eval-sentry webhook path; opt-in per-route flag so no default overhead.

Maria (ML): Default alert baseline approach: rolling 7-day baseline, min 50 requests, trigger if current_rate < baseline_rate - max(0.03, 3*baseline_std). Example rule we will provide to pilots: { "alert_name": "per_prompt_accuracy_drop", "baseline_window_days": "7", "min_requests": "50", "condition": "(current_rate < baseline_rate - max(0.03, 3*baseline_std))", "notify": "eval-sentry-webhook" } (this is an example stringified config for pilots).

Tom (SE): Advisor outputs should include: recommended rollback command, fallback_model_key, and TTL for rec validity. Ops will need a canned remediation snippet customers can copy into their orchestration.

Jana (PM): Acceptance criteria for Phase 1: advisor causes <5% overhead (p50/p95) when enabled; alerts produce <=5 false positives/day per pilot customer; 2 pilot customers fully onboarded and sign off; onboarding guide & runbook published; sales one-pager + pilot feedback template created. Anything missing?

Priya (CS): Add requirement: schedule a 60min training call per pilot and a post-pilot feedback session. I'll own sales one-pager + feedback template.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advisor/phase1 -> staging at 2024-06-10T18:00Z :rocket:

Eric (Eng): I'll break into three tickets: ADVISOR-1 rec-gen backend, ADVISOR-2 dashboard read-only, ADVISOR-3 eval-webhook integration. ETA and resource ask by EOD.

Jana (PM): Please make the RFC concise: slices, risks, mitigations, and pilot checklist. I'll coordinate pilot invites with Solutions & Sales.

Tom (SE): Will draft fallback examples and rollout snippet. :thumbsup:

Maria (ML): I'll produce a baseline calculation notebook and suggested alert templates for low-, mid-, and high-volume routes.

Priya (CS): Drafting pilot materials now.

Jana (PM): Thanks. Small, conservative Phase 1 gives visible value and reduces operational risk. Reconvene after RFC posted.
